name: WP Engine Production Deploy
description: Deploys a theme, plugin or mu-plugin to WP Engine production from a vX.Y.Z release tag. The Release Please workflow calls it when its Release PR merges, or you run it by hand for an existing tag. It waits until a backup (a restore point) is complete, and does not deploy without one. Needs the WPE_SSHG_KEY_PRIVATE, WPE_API_USER_ID and WPE_API_PASSWORD secrets and the WPE_PROD_ENV and BACKUP_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL variables. Add it together with the Release Please template.
